# Claradix

> Claradix is a digital agency based in Baku, Azerbaijan. It builds web
> platforms, brand identity, software and digital marketing for companies that
> want an idea turned into a working product. Its positioning line is "the
> bridge between your idea and reality".

The full Claradix website is currently in development. This page is a temporary
placeholder while the new site is built. Nothing here is out of date on purpose;
there is simply not more to say yet.

## Company

- Legal name: Claradix LLC
- Founded and based in: Baku, Azerbaijan
- Address: Babək prospekti, Babək plaza 14C, Baku, Azerbaijan
- Email: info@claradix.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +994 50 443 19 29
- Working languages: Azerbaijani, English, Russian

## Services

- Web platform design and development
- Brand identity and visual design
- Custom software development
- Digital marketing, SEO and paid acquisition
- Digital strategy and consulting
